title: ShinyHunters: alleged member Rey detained in Jordan over FBI data theft case
content_md:
ShinyHunters, the collective linked to massive breaches (Snowflake, Ticketmaster and others), has one of its alleged members, "Rey", detained in Jordan and cooperating in connection with the FBI data theft case.

via Mastodon https://hackread.com/shinyhunters-hacker-rey-detained-jordan-fbi/
